Messages.Author: David Pontes
Messages.Body:
Hello there! Today one of my opponents said that he once had an
argument about the steal blood strikes for Thaum. and the answer from
custserv was that the cards have errata so that they can only be played
at long range. Is this true?

David Pontes

8[

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


Absolutely not. There is no errata on any ranged strike restricting
it to "only at long range". Only cards who have that restriction
printed on them possess that restriction (and those cards have
obvious reasons for the restriction - reasons that do not apply to
Theft of Vitae / Drain Essence).

The only range-restricted steal blood strike is Tongue of the Serpent,
which is only effective at close range, by card text.
